skill_name: Write a 140-word article describing the benefits of using a cloud service.
workflow: Cloud computing has become an increasingly popular way for businesses to store data and applications. Cloud services offer a number of advantages over local storage solutions, from scalability and cost-efficiency to improved security. With a cloud service, companies can access data and apps from any device connected to the internet, making it much easier for employees to collaborate and work efficiently.
